gloss: end of term; end of semester

definitions.gloss: end of term; end of semester
definitions.explanation: The final period of a school term, when end-of-term exams, evaluations, and closing ceremonies take place. Used in elementary, secondary, and tertiary education.

examples.japanese: {学期末|がっきまつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいて→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧きた。
examples.english: The end of the term is approaching.

examples.japanese: {学期末|がっきまつ}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying for the end-of-term exams.

examples.japanese: {学期末|がっきまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成績表|せいせきひょう}→成績表：09289_seisekihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{配|くば}られ→配る：03921_kubaru⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面談|めんだん}→面談：08177_mendan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: At the end of the term, report cards are handed out and meetings with teachers are held.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{学期|がっき}→学期：01073_gakki⟧ (school term) + {末|まつ} (end). The Japanese school year has either two terms (⟦{前期|ぜんき}→前期：20651_zenki⟧/⟦{後期|こうき}→後期：12603_kouki⟧) or three trimesters (⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧/⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧/⟦{三|さん}{学期|がっき}→三学期：30250_sangakki⟧), each with its own {学期末|がっきまつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学期末|がっきまつ}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: end-of-term exam
- {学期末|がっきまつ}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧: end-of-term test (casual)
- {学期末|がっきまつ}⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧: end-of-term evaluation
- {学期末|がっきまつ}⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧: end-of-term break

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{学期|がっき}→学期：01073_gakki⟧: school term, semester
- ⟦{期末|きまつ}→期末：22375_kimatsu⟧: end of term (general, including work)
- ⟦{年度末|ねんどまつ}→年度末：10202_nendomatsu⟧: end of the (school/fiscal) year
